definitions.dossier: Same selected directory: saved search_log query, source URL, extract OR analytical summary, publisher plus title/date metadata, and all nine core files. This is evidence presence, not eligibility or official completion.
definitions.explicit_excerpt: Source card has nonempty snippet/excerpt/body_evidence/evidence_excerpt/quote; analytical summary alone excluded.
definitions.current_review: All declared manifest inputs and eight current core evidence anchors hash-match; exact observed independent reviewer identity.
definitions.selection: Registered effective directory where present; otherwise delivered status, then saved query count/source count/version path.
